notes.title: Demo Launch Announcement: పల్లెటూరు - Palm Sugar: A Village Story
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45032681/0518ffe91b2e5b6b5d3df8c67552fd0f5ab74730.png[/img]


We're excited to share that the demo for పల్లెటూరు - Palm Sugar: A Village Story will be available on September 16 at 18:00 hrs (India time)!

Explore the charm and simplicity of life in a traditional Indian village in this story-driven adventure. You'll experience the daily rhythms, culture, and community of rural life through your journey.

This demo is just the beginning, and we can't wait for you to dive in and share your thoughts with us! Your feedback is invaluable as we continue to shape the game's final version.

Follow our Steam page to stay updated with the latest news, updates, and future releases. We're eager to hear from the community and will be on the lookout for your feedback once the demo is live.

Thank you for your support!
